question:
Select the option that expresses the given sentence in passive voice.

The new sunshades have protected our windows during the rainy season.
options: Our windows are being protected by the new sunshades during the rainy season.
Our windows have been protected by the new sunshades during the rainy season
Our windows are being protected by the new windows during the rainy season.
Our sunshades have been protected by the new windows during the rainy season.
solution:
The correct answer is Option 2.
 
Key Points
  • Passive voice structure: The object of the active voice sentence becomes the subject of the passive voice sentence.
  • In the active voice, the sentence is: "The new sunshades have protected our windows during the rainy season."
  • To convert to passive voice: Place the object "our windows" at the beginning.
  • Change the active verb form "have protected" to "have been protected" (present perfect passive).
  • Add the preposition "by" followed by the original subject "the new sunshades."
  • Ensure the time phrase "during the rainy season" remains at the end of the sentence for clarity.
Therefore, the correct answer is Option 2.
 
Correct Sentence: "Our windows have been protected by the new sunshades during the rainy season."
 
Additional Information
  • Option 1: "Our windows are being protected by the new sunshades during the rainy season." – Incorrect tense (present continuous passive).
  • Option 3: "Our windows are being protected by the new windows during the rainy season." – Incorrect subject ("new windows" instead of "new sunshades").
  • Option 4: "Our sunshades have been protected by the new windows during the rainy season." – Incorrect subject and object swap.

question:
Select the option that expresses the given sentence in passive voice.

I remember my mother taking me to the stadium.
options: I remember being taken to the stadium by my mother.
I was taken to the stadium by mother that I remembered.
My mother remembered me taken to the stadium.
I was remembered being taken to the stadium by my mother
solution:
The correct answer is Option 1.
 
Key Points
  • Passive voice structure: The object of the active voice sentence becomes the subject of the passive voice sentence.
  • In the active voice, the sentence is: "I remember my mother taking me to the stadium."
  • To convert to passive voice: Place the object "me" at the beginning.
  • Change the active verb form "taking" to "being taken" (passive gerund).
  • Add the preposition "by" followed by the original subject "my mother."
  • Ensure the time phrase "to the stadium" remains at the end of the sentence for clarity.
Therefore, the correct answer is Option 1.
 
Correct Sentence: "I remember being taken to the stadium by my mother."
 
Additional Information
  • Option 2: "I was taken to the stadium by mother that I remembered." – Incorrect structure and meaning.
  • Option 3: "My mother remembered me taken to the stadium." – Incorrect subject and verb form.
  • Option 4: "I was remembered being taken to the stadium by my mother." – Incorrect structure and meaning.

question:
Select the option that expresses the given sentence in indirect speech.

The patient says, “I am fine.”
options: The patient says that he will be fine.
The patient says that he is fine.
The patient says that he would be fine.
The patient says that he was fine.
solution:
The correct answer is Option 2.
 
Key Points
  • Indirect Speech: The patient says that he is fine.
  • Key Conversions:
    • "I am fine" becomes "he is fine"
      • Pronoun "I" is changed to "he" to reflect the third person in indirect speech.
      • Verb "am" is changed to "is" to match the subject "he".
    • Reporting verb:
      • Indirect: "says"
      • Remains the same as it is in the present tense.
  • Punctuation and Format:
    • Direct speech is converted to a reported clause.
    • Quotation marks are removed in indirect speech.
Therefore, the correct answer is Option 2.
 
Correct Sentence: The patient says that he is fine.
 
Additional Information
  • Option 1: The patient says that he will be fine.
    • Changes the meaning to future tense, which is incorrect.
  • Option 3: The patient says that he would be fine.
    • Uses conditional "would" which changes the meaning.
  • Option 4: The patient says that he was fine.
    • Changes the tense to past, which is incorrect.

question:
Select the correct indirect form of the given sentence.

Renu said to her brother, “You were watching the show without me.”
options: Renu told her brother that he had been watching the show without her.
Renu told her brother that he has been watching the show without her.
Renu told her brother that he had watched the show without her.
Renu told her brother that he were watching the show without her.
solution:
The correct answer is option 1) i.e. 'Renu told her brother that he had been watching the show without her.'

Key Points

  • The given sentence is in Direct Speech. As per the given directions, we have to change it into Indirect Speech.
  • The given sentence is an assertive sentence.
  • The process of transformation is as follows:
  • The conjunction 'that' will be added and comma and inverted commas will be removed.
  • In the Indirect speech 'said to' will be changed into 'told' because the reporting verb has an object, 'her brother.'
  • The indirect speech will begin like 'Renu told her brother that.'
  • Now we have to change the reported speech.
  • Here the pronoun 'you' will be changed into 'he' and 'me' will be changed into 'her.'
  • The past continuous 'were watching' will be changed into the past perfect continuous 'had been watching.'
  • Finally, the indirect speech is 'Renu told her brother that he had been watching the show without her.'
  • ​So, the correct answer is option 1.

 

Correct Sentence: Renu told her brother that he had been watching the show without her.

question:

The painting was admired by art enthusiasts from around the world.

Art enthusiasts from around the world have admired the painting.

solution:

Therefore, the correct answer is Option 2.

Additional Information
